verdict.rationale: There is no llms.txt (the probe got HTTP 404), but TruffleHog serves its docs as raw markdown with frontmatter at docs.md. Individual pages are also available as .md (pre-commit-hooks.md, custom-detectors.md, customizing-detection.md, analyzers.md, getting-started.md), so an agent can ingest clean markdown docs. missing for 10: an llms.txt index, explicitly agent-oriented documentation, and independent confirmation that agents use these docs.
